ServicesPage.faq_description: Answers to the questions we hear most often.

faq.q: How fast do I get a quote?
faq.a: Usually within 24 hours on working days. For standard lanes often within just a few hours – simply use the inquiry form or call us directly.

faq.q: Do you also deliver to the UK?
faq.a: Yes, with our own daily lines to Witham (Essex) and Stoke-on-Trent. We handle full customs clearance, including EORI, ENS and Brexit documentation.
Every shipment gets a KED tracking number. In the customer portal you see status, location and ETA in real time. On request you receive automatic status emails at key milestones.

faq.q: Do you offer ADR or dangerous goods transports?
faq.a: Yes, with ADR-certified vehicles, trained staff and corresponding warehouse space. Please provide the UN number and class with your inquiry.
Standard is 30 days net from invoice date. For new customers we run a quick credit check; for ongoing relationships individual terms are possible.

About.page_description: Meet the team of KED Global Logistics: Dawoud The Navi (Operations), Markus Long John Kempf (Business Development), Carlos Engel (Digital Services). Stuttgart, 20+ years of experience, our own UK network.
About.hero_description: A forwarding company from Stuttgart – owner-led, personal, technological. We combine classic forwarding expertise with consistent digitalization and a strong UK network.
About.story_p1: Behind KED Global Logistics stand three managing directors who have built decades of forwarding experience in Stuttgart, Europe and Great Britain.
About.story_p2: What sets us apart: short paths, personal contacts and a clear commitment to quality and digitalization. We operate our own Transport Management System, a customer portal and an exclusive UK network – so your shipments are transparent and predictable at all times.
About.story_image_alt: KED Global Logistics dispatch: staff at monitors with live tracking
About.team_description: Three profiles, three areas of responsibility – one shared line: logistics that delivers.
About.team_photo_alt_thenavi: Dawoud The Navi – Head of Operations – KED Global Logistics
About.team_photo_alt_kempf: Markus Long John Kempf – Head of Business Development & Solutions – KED Global Logistics
About.team_photo_alt_engel: Carlos Engel – Head of Digital Business Services – KED Global Logistics

thenavi.name: Dawoud The Navi
thenavi.description: With over 20 years of international forwarding experience, Dawoud The Navi is responsible for the operational core of KED Global Logistics. His focus is on end-to-end process optimization, logistics automation and the consistent digitalization of all transport and warehouse operations. As the driving force behind the company's internationalization, he has built strategic partnerships – including the exclusive UK network with England Logistics in Witham and Stoke – and brought them to operational maturity. His areas of responsibility include dispatch, warehouse management, subcontractor coordination, quality management according to DIN EN ISO 9001, compliance (ADR/dangerous goods, customs clearance) and operational scaling for shipment volumes of up to 100,000 shipments per day.

kempf.name: Markus Long John Kempf
kempf.description: Markus Long John Kempf develops tailored logistics solutions for demanding industrial and commercial customers. As an expert in supply chain management, he designs holistic concepts that go far beyond classic transport: from supplier integration to warehouse strategies and last-mile delivery. His goal is to provide every customer with a predictable, transparent and scalable supply chain – integrated into their ERP systems, with real-time visibility and clear KPIs. In sales, he combines deep operational understanding with strategic consulting expertise.

engel.name: Carlos Engel
engel.description: Carlos Engel is responsible for digital transformation and the financial backbone of KED Global Logistics. As the interface between IT, Finance and Operations, he ensures that every shipment is seamlessly mapped not only physically but also digitally – from order entry through our proprietary Transport Management System (TMS) to DATEV-compliant invoicing. His responsibilities include IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, GDPR compliance, reporting and the continuous development of digital customer services such as the customer portal, live tracking and API integrations.

About.values_description: Five principles we measure ourselves against every day.

fast.title: Fast.
fast.description: Short response times, direct decision-making. With us you get a quote in under 24 hours – not in a week. Shipments are dispatched same-day, issues resolved immediately.

flexible.title: Flexible.
flexible.description: Express shipments, ADR, oversized cargo, direct delivery, refrigerated transport or crane goods – we solve what others reject. Our dispatch thinks ahead, not just by the book. Every inquiry is reviewed individually, every solution fits the customer.

transparent.title: Transparent.
transparent.description: You know where your goods are at all times. Live tracking via QR code, digital CMR documents, instant POD access in the customer portal. No phone calls needed – everything digital, always up to date.

digital.title: Digital.
digital.description: We use our own Transport Management System: from the first call to invoicing, fully digital. No Excel sheets, no paperwork, no media disruption. That saves time – yours and ours.

whatever.title: Whatever it takes.
whatever.description: This is more than a slogan. We take care of your entire supply chain – from supplier pickup to end customer delivery, including customs clearance, warehousing, cross-docking and returns. So you can focus on what matters: your growth.

About.cta_description: You can reach our management and dispatch directly – no call centre, no detours.

sections.title: 1. Privacy at a glance
paragraphs: The following notes provide a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data that can be used to identify you personally.
For detailed information please refer to the sections below.

sections.title: 2. Controller
paragraphs:
Responsible for data processing on this website is:
KED Global Logistics GmbH
[Street + number], 70173 Stuttgart, Germany
Email: datenschutz@ked-global-logistics.de
Phone: +49 711 [PLACEHOLDER]

sections.title: 3. Hosting
paragraphs: We host our website with Vercel Inc., 340 S Lemon Ave #4133, Walnut CA 91789, USA. When the site is accessed, technical data (IP address, date, browser) are transmitted.

Vercel is certified under the Standard Contractual Clauses. Where possible, processing takes place in the eu-central-1 region (Frankfurt). Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest in reliable provision).

sections.title: 4. Server log files
paragraphs: When you visit the website, data are automatically stored in so-called log files: IP address, date and time, page accessed, data volume, browser, operating system.
These data are stored for a maximum of 7 days and serve the security and stability of the operation. They are not merged with other data sources.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
paragraphs: We use technically necessary cookies (session, security) as well as – with your consent – cookies for statistics and marketing.
You can change your settings at any time via the cookie banner. Legal basis for non-essential cookies: Art. 6 (1) lit. a GDPR.

sections.title: 6. Contact form
paragraphs: If you send us inquiries via the contact form, your details will be stored to process the request and for any follow-up questions.

Processed data: name, company, email, phone (optional), service type, message.
Purpose: handling your inquiry.
Retention: 6 months after last contact, unless a business relationship arises.
Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) lit. b GDPR (pre-contractual measures).

sections.title: 7. Customer portal
paragraphs: In the customer portal we process login data, session cookies and shipment-related information that is necessary to fulfil your order.
Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) lit. b GDPR (contract performance).

sections.title: 8. Your rights

TermsPage.page_description: General Terms and Conditions of KED Global Logistics GmbH based on ADSp 2017 and our forwarding and warehousing services.
TermsPage.adsp_callout_body: We work exclusively on the basis of the German Forwarders' Standard Terms (Allgemeine Deutsche Spediteurbedingungen 2017, ADSp 2017). Clause 23.1.2 limits statutory liability for cargo damage under § 431 HGB for damages in the warehouse and transport area to EUR 1.00 per kilogram and per loss event to EUR 1,000,000.00 or 2 SDR per kilogram, whichever is higher.

sections.title: 1. Scope
paragraphs: These General Terms and Conditions apply to all contracts between KED Global Logistics GmbH ("KED") and its customers regarding forwarding, transport, warehousing and logistics services.
Deviating terms of the customer are not accepted unless KED expressly agrees to their applicability in writing.

sections.title: 2. Forwarding services
paragraphs: KED provides groupage, direct and UK shipments as well as warehousing and handling services. Acceptance as a carrier only takes place if expressly agreed.
Otherwise KED acts as a forwarder within the meaning of §§ 453 et seq. HGB.

sections.title: 3. Rates and conditions
paragraphs: Quotations are non-binding until written order confirmation. Tariffs and fuel surcharges may be adjusted in case of significant market changes after prior notice.
Special tariffs (e.g. ADR, oversize, express) are listed separately.

sections.title: 4. Payment terms
paragraphs: Invoices are payable without deduction within 14 days of the invoice date. In case of default, statutory default interest will be charged.
Set-off with counterclaims is only permitted with undisputed or legally established claims. Assignment of claims against KED requires written consent.

sections.title: 5. Liability
paragraphs: KED's liability is governed by ADSp 2017, in particular Clause 23 (limitation of liability). No liability beyond the ADSp is assumed.
We recommend taking out a transport and forwarding insurance (e.g. "SLVS").

sections.title: 6. Dangerous goods
paragraphs: Dangerous goods must be reported in writing prior to the order (UN number, class, packaging group, quantity). Shipments must be packed, labelled and documented in accordance with ADR.
Without proper prior notification we are entitled to refuse acceptance.

sections.title: 7. Force majeure
paragraphs: In the event of force majeure (e.g. strikes, natural disasters, official orders), contractual obligations are suspended for the duration of the impediment. Resulting delays do not give rise to liability.

sections.title: 8. Data protection
paragraphs: The processing of personal data is carried out in accordance with our privacy policy.

sections.title: 9. Place of jurisdiction and applicable law
paragraphs: Exclusive place of jurisdiction for all disputes is Stuttgart, provided that the customer is a merchant.
German law applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG). For cross-border road transports the provisions of the CMR apply additionally.

sections.title: 10. Severability
paragraphs: Should individual provisions of these terms be or become invalid in whole or in part, the validity of the remaining provisions shall not be affected. The invalid provision shall be replaced by a regulation that comes closest to the economic purpose of the invalid provision.
